entries.description: An intentional community of 3 lesbian residents with housing, permanent structures, and farm land, engaged in crop sharing and gardening.
entries.raw_text: system of crop sharing/gardening. Ongoing projects include bridge and road construction, gardening, selecting and cutting wood, fencing, building campsites and shelters, and gathering materials. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 3 lesbians, land, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space (no sites), woods, farm land, women living and workin' on the land. Inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Continues previous page. community_name is unstated as the listing starts mid-sentence. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on residents living and working on the land. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from directory context and listing mentioning 3 lesbians, Non-lesbian women and Girl children explicitly welcomed. Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency based on crop sharing/gardening and farm land.

entries.description: A private 5-acre rural desert farm owned by two lesbian feminists for 15 years, raising vegetables, herbs, and animals, welcoming lesbian-oriented women and girl children.
entries.raw_text: ARLENE & ARLINE PO Box 511, Desert Hot Springs, CA 92240 (619)329-8916. (25 miles NE of Palm Springs in a rural desert area). We are two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years. We have been rural wimmin for 9 years, 3 years of which on our farm. We raise our own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees; many flowers. We live simply and creatively (no TV) and do enjoy sharing our skills with wimmin oriented lesbians (non-racist, non-classist etc) interested in rural life. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 5 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land due to the two-woman rule ('two lesbian feminists... on our farm'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from directory and description, Girl children explicitly welcomed. Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency based on raising vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees.

entries.description: A commercial dairy and cheese plant, truck gardening, and homestead with six dwellings, welcoming lesbians to lease operations or buy shares. Drug-free.
entries.raw_text: KIDS-LL-EAT IVY FARM 1220 Georgetown Rd, Cool, CA 95614 (916)823-3009. A thriving commercial dairy and cheeseplant, truck gardening, various homestead animals and horses. Six dwellings with all conveniences, spa, greenhouse, pond, barns, pasture. I welcome lesbians to lease out part of commercial operations or buy shares in the property. Requires money and responsibility. Must have country-living-animal experience and be interested, as well as believe in, ecologically run, woman owned commercial farming. NO DRUGS.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land as it is woman-owned ('I welcome lesbians...'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from directory context. Focuses: Recovery/substance-free due to 'NO DRUGS.'; Farming/self-sufficiency due to commercial dairy, cheeseplant, truck gardening.

entries.description: A pacifist, vegetarian agricultural community on 120 acres with 1 member and 120 nonlesbians/others, practicing organic agriculture and communal child raising, welcoming all genders.
entries.raw_text: NOTE: The following is not a women's land group, but it does welcome lesbians as visitors or members. FOLLY FARM 9380 Hebo Rd, Grand Ronde, OR 97347 (503)879-5649. We are pacifists, vegetarians, and we practice organic agriculture, permaculture, and communal child raising. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians, 120 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women and men living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Notes beginning 'NOT WOMEN'S LAND' per codebook for groups that are not women's land groups but welcome lesbians. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because residents live and work on the land together. Residents count: 1 lesbian + 5 nonlesbians = 6 residents (or listing says '1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians' as the breakdown, but population total mentioned or calculated from list; listing says '1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians, 120 acres'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children, and Non-gay men / Gay men (since men live and work on the land, though standard coding for 'women and men' gives Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children, Gay men, Non-gay men). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency for organic agriculture and permaculture.

entries.description: A 10-acre wooded property with lake frontage and housekeeping units, owned by 1 lesbian and welcoming nonlesbian women, children, and pets.
entries.raw_text: NOTE: These groups don't have land, per se, or they aren't exactly land groups, but we included them for your information. WILDERNESS WAY Box 176, Wascott, WI 54890. (715)466-2635. Wilderness Way is located on 10 wooded acres with 260 feet of lake frontage. There are 3 two bedroom housekeeping units each with fully equipped kitchen and bath, and living room area. The campground includes electric hook-ups, indoor bathroom facilities with hot showers and an indoor camper lounge area. Swimming, fishing, canoeing, bicycling, hiking, horseback riding and cross country skiing. Owned by 1 lesbian. Other lesbians active in planning special events and sharing management tasks. We welcome: nonlesbian women, girl and boy children, cats and dogs.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land due to 'Owned by 1 lesbian.' Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred from directory and owner), Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast just 9 miles south of Mendocino
entries.description: A private 2-acre cabin in the Mendocino redwoods offering lodging for guests, welcoming nonlesbian women.
entries.raw_text: PEPPERLAND PO Box 464, Albion, CA 95410 (707)937-0020. We have a quiet, private cabin with detached, shared, bathroom facilities, $20 per night (up to 3 people). We are in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast just 9 miles south of Mendocino. We welcome: nonlesbian women. We have: 2 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it operates as a rental cabin for visitors ('$20 per night'). Land location city inferred as Albion from mailing address, and stated location in Redwoods. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred from directory context), Non-lesbian women.
